articles.author: Alexa Philippou
articles.title: White rips critics, backed by Clark, Cunningham after fans boo - ESPN
articles.description: Fever coach Stephanie White spoke out against her critics and received vocal support from Caitlin Clark and Sophie Cunningham after she was booed in Indiana before Tuesday's win over the Liberty.
